legend: Abdulghafour is a player who loves football. His friend Abo Al-Jood does too.

Every time they play, each one is on a different team. And of course, the team that Abo Al-Jood plays on always loses. But this time, Abdulghafour gave Abo Al-Jood a condition. He told him he must solve a task if he wants to be on the same team and win.
Help Abo Al-Jood solve the task so he can play on the winning team.
You are given an array A$$$A$$$ of N$$$N$$$ integers. Also, you are given Q$$$Q$$$ queries, there are two types of queries:
Update Query: '1$$$1$$$ i$$$i$$$ val$$$val$$$' Update the element at position i$$$i$$$ to val$$$val$$$; Ai←$$$A_i \gets$$$ val$$$val$$$.
Find Query: '2$$$2$$$ i$$$i$$$' Find any position j$$$j$$$ in the array such that |(i−j)3|≥Aj$$$|(i - j)^3| \ge A_j$$$
For a find query, If such a position j$$$j$$$ exists, print any valid j$$$j$$$. If no such position exists, print -1.
input: The first line contains an integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105$$$1 \le N \le 10^5$$$) — the length of the array.
The second line contains N$$$N$$$ integers A1,A2,…,AN$$$A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_N$$$ (1≤Ai≤109$$$1 \le A_i \le 10^9$$$) — the elements of the array.
The third line contains an integer Q$$$Q$$$ (1≤Q≤105$$$1 \le Q \le 10^5$$$) — the number of queries.
Each of the next Q$$$Q$$$ lines contains a query in one of the following forms:
1$$$1$$$ i$$$i$$$ val$$$val$$$ (1≤i≤N$$$1 \le i \le N$$$, 1≤val≤109$$$1 \le val \le 10^9$$$) — an Update Query.
2$$$2$$$ i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤N$$$1 \le i \le N$$$) — a Find Query.
output: For each query of type 2$$$2$$$, output any valid index j$$$j$$$ that satisfies the condition, or -1 if no such index exists.
